therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Targeted radiotherapy + PARP inhibition + androgen synthesis inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell DNA damage and death via radioligand therapy combined with DNA repair inhibition and androgen deprivation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Determination of recommended phase 2 dose and PSA-50 response rate

results.dose_information: 177Lu-PSMA-617: 7.4 GBq IV every 6 weeks for 6 cycles; Niraparib/abiraterone: 200mg/1000mg, 150mg/1000mg, 100mg/1000mg, or 50mg/500mg orally daily; Prednisone: 5mg orally twice daily

context.investigator_commentary: Funding for the study was withdrawn.
